items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Kid Kemp? [INTERVIEWEE] No. One of them kind of names.

ctx.x: watched the papers. And Steele(?) said he went in... So they closed the pub down and left these drums in there. The police made him get out after the killing, see. So he goes home. So he gets phone calls. They wanted him to play somewhere. He said he wouldn't take no chances. So he said they found his house, and then he had to stay inside for about a month, because the gangsters would come around and ask guys to book Steele(?) again, because they figured Steele(?) would describe them -- and they were going to…

No. One of them kind of names. So he'd tell me all...you know, who was (?). And he'd see old performers, old musicians. He'd say "Do you see that woman? That woman..." I'm trying to think of this woman's name. He said, "That woman performed for the Tsar of Russia." She was a little dark woman. She was what you call... She did a whole lot of tumbling.
